commands.title: Refresh Git Status
commands.description: Refresh the git status of the workspace repos.

commands.title: Stage All Changes
commands.description: Stage all changes (git add -A) in every workspace repo.

commands.title: Unstage All
commands.description: Unstage all staged changes in every workspace repo.

commands.title: Review Branch
commands.description: Review the current branch of the selected (or first) workspace repo against its default base branch in the editor.

commands.title: End Review
commands.description: End the branch review and close its editor tab.

commands.title: List Worktrees
commands.description: List the git worktrees of every git folder of the workspace, the main checkout first. Returns [{repo, path, branch, head, main, current}]: repo is the workspace folder, path the worktree root, branch is empty when detached, head is the short SHA, and current marks the worktree the folder is switched to.

commands.title: Switch Worktree
commands.description: Switch a workspace folder to one of its git worktrees: the files tree, git, search, the editor and new terminals follow it. A folder that is a repo subdirectory maps to the same subdirectory of the worktree.

repo.description: Workspace folder; defaults to the first git folder.

path.description: Worktree root, as listed by git.worktrees.

commands.title: New Worktree
commands.description: Start creating the worktree <main checkout>/.worktrees/<branch>, then switch to it. Checks out the branch when it exists, else creates it from HEAD of the current worktree. Adds .worktrees/ to .git/info/exclude when the repo does not ignore it. Returns {id}; poll git.worktree-op-status for the outcome. Fails at once on an invalid branch, an existing folder, a symlinked .worktrees, or while another git operation runs.

repo.description: Workspace folder; defaults to the first git folder.

branch.description: Branch name, also the folder name under .worktrees/.

commands.title: Worktree Operation Status
commands.description: Wait up to 1 s for a worktree create or remove started by git.worktree-new or git.worktree-remove. Returns {done, error?, path?}; path is the new worktree after a successful create.

id.description: Operation id returned by git.worktree-new or git.worktree-remove.

commands.title: Worktree Sessions
commands.description: List the workspace's running sessions whose working directory is inside the given worktree, except the editor's own Neovim sessions. Returns [{id, title}].

commands.title: Remove Worktree
commands.description: Start removing a linked git worktree: stops its Neovim, runs git worktree remove and, when it was current, switches the folder back to its own checkout. Never removes the main checkout, a worktree with uncommitted changes, or the branch. Returns {id}; poll git.worktree-op-status for the outcome.

repo.description: Workspace folder; defaults to the first git folder.

path.description: Worktree root, as listed by git.worktrees.

force.description: Stop the worktree's Neovim even with unsaved buffers, discarding their changes.
